blocks.html: This method emits one or more events. Subscribers listening to the event(s) are executed asynchronously.

types.name: data
types.description: The details of the events to emit.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Additional meadata to pass with the event.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description:
The ID of the event's group. Grouped events are useful when you have distributed transactions
where you need to explicitly group, release and clear events upon lifecycle events of a transaction.

When set, you must release the grouped events using the Event Module's `releaseGroupedEvents` method to emit the events.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the event was emitted.

children.name: published_at
children.description: The date the event was published to the event bus. If it's a grouped event, this will be the date the group was released.

children.name: data
children.description: The data payload that subscribers receive. For example, the ID or IDs of the created user. (e.g. { id: "123" } or { ids: ["123", "456"] })

types.name: options
types.description: Additional options for the event.

types.name: Promise
types.description: This method emits one or more events. Subscribers listening to the event(s) are executed asynchronously.

blocks.html: This method adds a subscriber to an event. It's mainly used internally to register subscribers.

types.name: eventName
types.description: The name of the event to subscribe to.

types.name: subscriber
types.description: The subscriber function to execute when the event is emitted.

types.name: context
types.description: The context of the subscriber.

children.name: subscriberId
children.description: The ID of the subscriber. Useful when retrying failed subscribers.

types.name: this
types.description: The instance of the Event Module

blocks.html: This method removes a subscriber from an event. It's mainly used internally to unregister subscribers.

types.name: eventName
types.description: The name of the event to unsubscribe from.

types.name: subscriber
types.description: The subscriber function to remove.

types.name: context
types.description: The context of the subscriber.

children.name: subscriberId
children.description: The ID of the subscriber. Useful when retrying failed subscribers.

types.name: this
types.description: The instance of the Event Module

blocks.html:
This method emits all events in the specified group. Grouped events are useful when you have distributed transactions
where you need to explicitly group, release and clear events upon lifecycle events of a transaction.

types.name: eventGroupId
types.description: The ID of the event group.

types.name: Promise
types.description:
This method emits all events in the specified group. Grouped events are useful when you have distributed transactions
where you need to explicitly group, release and clear events upon lifecycle events of a transaction.

blocks.html:
This method removes all events in the specified group. Grouped events are useful when you have distributed transactions
where you need to explicitly group, release and clear events upon lifecycle events of a transaction.

types.name: eventGroupId
types.description: The ID of the event group.

types.name: options
types.description: Additional options for the event.

children.name: eventNames
children.description:
The names of the events to clear. If not provided, The group will
be entirely cleared.

types.name: Promise
types.description:
This method removes all events in the specified group. Grouped events are useful when you have distributed transactions
where you need to explicitly group, release and clear events upon lifecycle events of a transaction.

called before the event is emitted.

types.description: The interceptor to add.
